reason: We have run our practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for ten years for free, and retraining rotating article clerks every two to three years on new software is a waste of time. Our current workflow already gets ROC annual filing annexures reviewed and filed on time without paying an annual subscription.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time when spreadsheets and WhatsApp already work.
would_change_my_mind: If the software is so dead simple that fresh article clerks can follow ROC filing checklists on day one with zero training, without adding extra manual forwarding steps.
